full_prompt_en: A square color studio photograph shows a young woman turning her head back over her near shoulder against a deep blue-black mottled background. Her body faces away toward the right, while the face turns left and slightly toward the camera. The viewpoint is close enough to show her head, shoulder, and upper back, with most of the lower body cropped out. Light brown hair is pulled into a loose high arrangement, with a long narrow braid falling down the far right and several fine strands framing the cheek. Her visible eye looks toward the viewer from the sideways pose; it is pale blue-gray beneath a defined brow. The nose projects in a clean profile and the lips are closed with a muted rose tone. A dark sleeveless garment crosses the upper back and leaves the near shoulder exposed. Across that shoulder is a large blue-black tattoo with warm orange and rust-colored areas, its curved shapes wrapping over the upper arm and following the round shoulder plane. A dark necklace or narrow band lies at the base of the neck. Soft directional light comes from the upper left and front, bringing a warm glow to forehead, cheek, nose, and tattooed shoulder. The far cheek, back, and braid fade into shadow, yet their outlines remain faintly visible. The background has cloudy slate-gray texture rather than a flat studio black, giving the figure a little depth without introducing objects. Color is restrained: warm flesh and tattoo orange stand against cool charcoal and dark blue. Fine skin texture and stray hairs stay visible, while the surroundings remain softly blurred. The composition is built around the turn of the face and the illuminated curve of the shoulder, making a quiet, direct glance the focal point within a broad dark field.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形彩色影棚照片描绘一名年轻女子越过近处肩膀回头，身后是深蓝黑斑驳背景。身体背向观者朝右，脸则转向左并稍望相机。视点足够贴近，只显示头、肩和上背，下半身大部分被裁掉。浅棕发松松挽高，一条长而窄的辫子沿最右侧垂下，几根细发框住脸颊。可见的一只眼从侧身姿态向观者看，颜色浅蓝灰，位于清楚眉线下。鼻子形成干净侧面，嘴唇闭合，带低调玫瑰色。深色无袖衣物横过上背，露出近处肩膀。肩上有大片蓝黑纹身，内有暖橙与锈色区域，弯曲形态绕过上臂，顺着圆润肩面延伸。深色项链或窄带位于颈根。柔和定向光从左上及前方来，给额头、颊、鼻和纹身肩部一层暖亮。远侧脸颊、后背和发辫渐入阴影，但轮廓仍依稀可见。背景有云雾般石板灰肌理，不是平整影棚黑，给人物一点纵深却不加入物件。色彩克制：暖肤色与纹身橙对着冷炭色和深蓝。细微皮肤肌理与散发保持可见，周围则柔软失焦。构图围绕面容的转动与受光肩线展开，让安静而直接的一眼成为宽阔暗色域中的焦点。
style_prompt_en: Color studio photography uses a close turning silhouette, soft side-front light, and a dark mottled ground to shape restrained volume. Warm amber and rose highlights occupy a small focal area against broad blue-black and charcoal shadow. Fine surface detail remains visible where light grazes a rounded plane, while farther edges fade gently into darkness. A narrow vertical line balances a wider curved foreground mass, giving the crop an asymmetrical but stable rhythm. Shallow background texture adds depth without competing with the lit center. The contrast is strong yet softly graded, with no hard spotlight rim. Color is concentrated in a few warm accents and surrounded by muted cool space, creating an intimate, direct visual mood.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色影棚摄影用贴近的转折剪影、柔和侧前光和深暗斑驳底色塑造克制体积。暖琥珀与玫瑰色亮处占据小块焦点，对着宽阔蓝黑和炭色阴影。细微表面细节在光擦过圆润平面时仍可看见，更远边缘则温和地融入黑暗。一条窄竖线平衡较宽的弯曲前景大块，让裁切不对称却稳定。浅背景纹理增添纵深，却不与受光中心争夺注意。反差强但渐层柔软，没有硬聚光边。色彩集中在少量暖点，周围是低调冷色空间，形成亲密而直接的视觉气息。
theme_en: A young woman looking back over a tattooed shoulder in dim light
theme_zh: 一名年轻女子在昏暗光线里越过有纹身的肩膀回望
name: Portrait shot over the shoulder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
